Platinum Redux version v3.2 encounter table

Note that there are no surfing or fishing encounters and there are no differences based on daytime. Encounters are sorted chronologically. Brackets show encounter percentages. If there are no brackets, the encounter chance is equally distributed. Every Pokémon can be found in one tall grass location and in one special location (Egg, Palmer, Trade etc.). Eggs have a unique location where they are supposed to be hatched. Please notice the creator on Discord if anything is unclear or there are mistakes. Enjoy the game!
